subject.title: macOS: Gateway daemon PATH excludes user bin dirs (nix, bun, local, etc.)

question: Should macOS Gateway LaunchAgents keep the canonical minimal PATH, gain an explicit operator opt-in for user bin directories, or include user bins by default?
rationale: Current source, tests, and docs intentionally harden macOS service PATHs, while the requested behavior improves Nix/Bun/local tool discovery and changes command-resolution trust; automation should not choose that product/security tradeoff.

options.title: Keep default minimal, add explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve the safe default and add a maintainer-approved service PATH opt-in only if schema, docs, doctor, and tests make the operator choice explicit.

options.title: Change the macOS default
options.body: Include Darwin user-bin directories by default, accepting the broader command-resolution surface and requiring fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Decline service PATH expansion
options.body: Leave daemon PATH policy unchanged and direct users to supported exec PATH controls or standard install locations.

recommendation.title: Keep default minimal, add explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve the safe default and add a maintainer-approved service PATH opt-in only if schema, docs, doctor, and tests make the operator choice explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc provided the clearest recent maintainer-side signal on adjacent managed service PATH precedence in the merged pnpm 11 PATH PR.
